Solana transaction adapter bundle

Generated from the installed, lockfile-pinned @solana/web3.js 1.99.0 with esbuild 0.28.2.
Entry: export {VersionedTransaction} from "@solana/web3.js"
Options: bundle=true, platform=browser, format=esm, target=es2022, minify=true, legalComments=eof.
The bundle is loaded only for injected Phantom transaction signing. It does not submit transactions.
